topography.project_purpose: Launchpad. Structurally: 61 project-authored contract(s) across 1 chain(s); 2 ERC4626 vaults, 4 ERC20 tokens, 2 ERC721 NFTs; role-gated via AccessControl; upgradeable via ERC1967/UUPS proxies; built on openzeppelin.
topography.relationship_narrative: The protocol comprises 2 functional families. Its contracts share 18 common project-authored base contract(s) (governable, initializegovernedupgradeabilityproxy, peripheryimmutablestate). Dominant framework: openzeppelin.
